reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the express warranty period is sixty (60) days measured from the Effective Date with a hard sunset of December 31, 1999, which falls below the playbook fallback of ninety (90) days for software and can expire before acceptance under Section 3.1.

The clause does not already sit at the fallback — remedies (correct, replace, terminate with refund of prepaid fees) and the no-malicious-code warranty are adequate, and the finding correctly limits the flag to duration rather than re-flagging satisfied elements.

The redline is targeted and directionally right for us as licensee (Corio): only the duration phrase is replaced with twelve (12) months from acceptance, leaving the remedy ladder in p0079 and the malicious-code sentence intact. The high changed-character ratio is an artifact of substituting the duration/sunset language; the surrounding text is unchanged.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, explains the acceptance-timing gap, and offers the ninety (90) day fallback as the playbook contemplates.
Reasonably declines to double-flag the disclaimer, noting it appears to reach only implied warranties and thus does not swallow the express warranty.
